title: Skeleton Phoenix Bleeding
description: A skeletal phoenix with a long curved horned beak stands on a dark mound, orange liquid dripping from its mouth and pooling below. The creature has detailed skeletal wings, ribs, and tail feathers, surrounded by floating bones, feathers, spiders, and bokeh light orbs against a smoky background.
prompt: A detailed skeletal phoenix creature stands on a dark mound with its head turned slightly left, long curved horn-like beak dripping thick orange liquid that pools on the ground below. The phoenix has intricate visible bones, ribcage, wings with feather details, and a long skeletal tail. Floating around it are individual bones, feathers, spiders, and soft bokeh light circles in warm tones against a smoky dark background with torn paper edges.
